title: Digital Output (Single Sample)
text: Output single sample to multiple digital lines of data acquisition device, 1 input, {Number of ports} sets Number of input data ports 1 for all lines; {Device}, {Lines} sets the device line selection and configuration options depend and {Sample time} sets the block execution rate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device
params.values: Device with which you want to generate data

params.name: Lines
params.values: Device line selection and configuration options depend on device

params.name: Number of ports
params.values: Number of input data ports 1 for all lines | 1 per line
